name: com.xengine.platform.harmonyos
description: Platform module for HarmonyOS builds: toolchain manifest driving download of the public OpenHarmony SDK (native + toolchains incl. hdc) from the Huawei Cloud open mirror and the XEngine OpenHarmony SDK Bundle (self-built, GitHub Releases) into the managed SDK root, then reusing the existing bundle-import / SDK-resolve chain. Metadata only — no binaries are redistributed.
